why_declaration_names_are_unaffected: 43 of the 50 Analysis modules use the flat namespace FunctionalInequalities.Analysis, and the three nested ones (Analysis.WhitneyCover, Analysis.WhitneyJet, Analysis.LipschitzJet) were not touched. A Lean namespace is independent of the file path, so moving a file cannot change a declaration's full name. Ledger nodes, Blueprint declarations, the statement-snapshot golden and every axiom report are therefore unaffected by construction, and the unchanged axiom totals confirm it empirically.
the_whitneycover_trap: WhitneyCover is BOTH a module name and a namespace name. The module Analysis.WhitneyCover became Analysis.Whitney.Cover while the namespace FunctionalInequalities.Analysis.WhitneyCover was left exactly as it was. The rewrite touched only import lines and Analysis/<File>.lean path strings in docstrings, never a bare identifier: of the 148 textual FunctionalInequalities.Analysis.<moved> occurrences, 126 were on import lines and the other 22 were inspected individually and are all that namespace and its declarations.
